items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Played with us a long time. Tenny Wilson. Tenny Wilson.

ctx.x: You never know when a Chinaman died? That's what I heard. It's disappeared, huh? Mm-hmm. Do you remember Junie Cobb?

That's the man who got me the job at Jeffrey Tabin. Two brothers, Junie Cobb and Jimmy Cobb. I was playing after, this was before I went to Golden Lily though, I just went to Chicago with the show, Mac and Mac. And we was playing at a little place called Bookstore. I tell you, her wife was playing the piano. Uh, what did this boy play so much piano? Played with us a long time. Tenny Wilson. Tenny Wilson. He had a little girl named Aurene, who was his wife. Good piano player. So she heard about me, she come and…
Law grab her and went in there and got all that stuff out of front of them. Yeah, Gene Carver got me a great job.
